finding_disagreements.prediction_reason: Document text checked, but graphical pages [13] were not inspected.
Power-up, power-down, and sequencing requirements were not located in the supplied excerpts. Page 10, Device Functional Modes, is absent, and document-wide canonical text search was not available.
Capacitor values and permitted types are supplied. Placement requirements remain unobserved because page 13, Layout Guidelines and Layout Example, was not supplied.

Charge-pump storage capacitors are documented, but separate bulk capacitance, inrush, and soft-start requirements were not located in the supplied excerpts. The incomplete evidence does not establish document-wide absence.
Supplied evidence selects charge-pump capacitances by supply voltage using a table; no component calculation equation is shown. Document-wide absence cannot be established from the supplied excerpts.

No external crystal or oscillator selection specification is shown in the supplied evidence. The charge-pump description and application circuit do not establish document-wide absence or explicit non-applicability.

Supplied D-package evidence contains a mechanical drawing but no recommended land pattern, PCB pad dimensions, or stencil relationship. Document-wide canonical search is unavailable; additional source evidence is needed.
The layout example labels Ground points but does not establish a ground plane, prescribed return paths or thermal-via requirements. Document-wide search evidence is unavailable.
No-load supply current is specified. Separate loaded operating-current and shutdown-current specifications are not located in the supplied excerpts; document-wide search was unavailable.

Input currents, receiver input resistance, output drive, slew rate, propagation delays and pulse skew are specified. Device input capacitance and separate device rise/fall times are not located in the supplied excerpts. The measurement diagrams specify generator rise/fall times, not device rise/fall times.

The supplied electrical and switching tables are readable, but the recommended-operating-conditions table on page 4 is missing. Consequently, its electrical limits and the complete recommended ranges referenced by these tables cannot be extracted.

The documented interface comprises two logic-to-RS-232 drivers and two RS-232-to-logic receivers with per-channel truth tables; device addressing is not applicable to these documented functions. However, the design procedure names FORCEOFF and FORCEON inputs that do not appear in the complete pin table.

Logic input limits, receiver levels and loading, and switching load conditions are available. The supplied page-5 evidence omits the driver electrical-characteristics table, preventing complete extraction of driver output levels and input loading.

Absolute junction-temperature limit and short-circuit dissipation precautions are supplied. Thermal shutdown and derating specifications cannot be established from the supplied excerpts; document-wide search was not available.
The contents identify Layout Guidelines and Layout Example on page 13, but that page is not supplied. Copper-area and thermal-via recommendations remain unobserved.
Data-rate limits are supplied, but clock-frequency limits by mode are not established. The supplied functional modes do not specify clocks; document-wide search was unavailable.
Powered and unpowered behavior is described without startup or reset timing. The supplied evidence does not establish whether such timing is specified elsewhere.

The selected MAX3232CD is consistently listed at 0 to 70 °C. However, MAX3232CDR1G4 and MAX3232CDR1G4.A are listed at −40 to 85 °C in the addendum, whereas the recommended operating conditions specify MAX3232C at 0 to 70 °C. MAX3232-EP is identified as another qualified version; the supplied evidence does not establish that qualification for MAX3232CD.

No explicit known-device-issue or errata list is stated in the supplied excerpts. A short-circuit precaution is stated. The design procedure references FORCEOFF and FORCEON inputs absent from the supplied MAX3232 application figure, leaving their applicability unresolved. Document-wide evidence is incomplete.

Explicit graph and waveform conditions are available. The supplied plots do not specify temperature or package and do not identify a safe operating area. Document-wide search was unavailable, so safe-operating-area coverage remains unresolved.
